verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a hosted SaaS monitoring platform like Honeybadger, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents region selection or data residency. The only nearby item is Insights data replication for longer retention, which is a different feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
